title: चतुःसप्ततितमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Bahuka weeps on seeing his children. Damayanti has him brought to her and asks whether he knows of a man who abandoned his sleeping wife; Nala blames Kali and asks how a faithful wife could choose another husband, and Damayanti, trembling, explains.
summary.kn: ಮಕ್ಕಳನ್ನು ಕಂಡು ಬಾಹುಕನು ಅಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ದಮಯಂತಿ ಅವನನ್ನು ಕರೆಸಿ ಮಲಗಿದ್ದ ಪತ್ನಿಯನ್ನು ಬಿಟ್ಟವನನ್ನು ಬಲ್ಲೆಯಾ ಎಂದು ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾಳೆ; ನಳನು ಕಲಿಯನ್ನು ದೂಷಿಸಿ ಪತಿವ್ರತೆ ಇನ್ನೊಬ್ಬ ಪತಿಯನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಆರಿಸಬಲ್ಲಳು ಎಂದು ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ; ನಡುಗುತ್ತಾ ದಮಯಂತಿ ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತಾಳೆ.
summary.hi: बच्चों को देखकर बाहुक रो पड़ता है। दमयन्ती उसे बुलवाकर पूछती हैं कि क्या वह सोती पत्नी को छोड़ने वाले किसी पुरुष को जानता है; नल कलि को दोष देकर पूछते हैं कि पतिव्रता दूसरा पति कैसे चुन सकती है, और दमयन्ती काँपते हुए समझाती हैं।
summary.te: పిల్లలను చూసి బాహుకుడు ఏడుస్తాడు. దమయంతి అతనిని పిలిపించి నిద్రిస్తున్న భార్యను విడిచినవానిని ఎరుగుదువా అని అడుగుతుంది; నలుడు కలిని నిందించి పతివ్రత మరో భర్తను ఎలా ఎంచుకోగలదని అడుగుతాడు; వణుకుతూ దమయంతి వివరిస్తుంది.
summary.ta: குழந்தைகளைக் கண்டு பாஹுகன் அழுகிறான். தமயந்தி அவனை அழைத்து, உறங்கும் மனைவியை விட்டுச் சென்ற ஒருவனைத் தெரியுமா என்று கேட்கிறாள்; நளன் கலியைக் குறைகூறி, கற்புடையவள் வேறு கணவனை எப்படித் தேர்வாள் என்று கேட்க, தமயந்தி நடுங்கியபடி விளக்குகிறாள்.
summary.ml: മക്കളെ കണ്ട് ബാഹുകൻ കരയുന്നു. ദമയന്തി അദ്ദേഹത്തെ തന്റെ അടുത്ത് വരുത്തി, ഉറങ്ങുന്ന ഭാര്യയെ ഉപേക്ഷിച്ചുപോയ ഒരാളെക്കുറിച്ച് അറിയുമോ എന്ന് ചോദിക്കുന്നു; നളൻ കലിയെ കുറ്റപ്പെടുത്തി, വിശ്വസ്തയായ ഭാര്യ മറ്റൊരു ഭർത്താവിനെ എങ്ങനെ തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുമെന്ന് ചോദിക്കുന്നു; വിറച്ചുകൊണ്ട് ദമയന്തി വിശദീകരിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 3.74; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 11 2022

verses.text: बृहदश्व उवाच

meaning.en: Brihadashva said:

verses.text:
सर्वं विकारं दृष्ट्वा तु पुण्यश्लोकस्य धीमतः ।
आगत्य केशिनी क्षिप्रं दमयन्त्यै न्यवेदयत् ॥

meaning.en: Having seen every strange sign in the wise man of holy fame, Keshini came back quickly and told Damayanti.

verses.text:
दमयन्ती ततो भूयः प्रेषयामास केशिनीम् ।
मातुः सकाशं दुःखार्ता नलशङ्कासमुत्सुका ॥

meaning.en: Then Damayanti, pained and eager because she suspected Nala, sent Keshini again, this time to her mother.

verses.text:
परीक्षितो मे बहुशो बाहुको नलशङ्कया ।
रूपे मे संशयस्त्वेकः स्वयमिच्छामि वेदितुम् ॥

meaning.en: She said, "I have tested Bahuka many times, suspecting him to be Nala. Only one doubt remains, about his appearance, and I wish to find it out myself.

verses.text:
स वा प्रवेश्यतां मातर्मां वानुज्ञातुमर्हसि ।
विदितं वाथ वाज्ञातं पितुर्मे संविधीयताम् ॥

meaning.en: Mother, either let him be brought in to me, or give me leave to go to him. Whether my father knows of it or not, let it be arranged."

verses.text:
एवमुक्ता तु वैदर्भ्या सा देवी भीममब्रवीत् ।
दुहितुस्तमभिप्रायमन्वजानाच्च पार्थिवः ॥

meaning.en: Told this by Vaidarbhi, the queen spoke to Bhima, and the king approved his daughter's wish.

verses.text:
सा वै पित्राभ्यनुज्ञाता मात्रा च भरतर्षभ ।
नलं प्रवेशयामास यत्र तस्याः प्रतिश्रयः ॥

meaning.en: With permission from her father and mother, O best of the Bharatas, Damayanti had Nala brought in to where she lived.

verses.text:
तं तु दृष्ट्वा तथायुक्तं दमयन्ती नलं तदा ।
तीव्रशोकसमाविष्टा बभूव वरवर्णिनी ॥

meaning.en: Seeing Nala in that state, the lovely Damayanti was overcome with sharp grief.

verses.text:
ततः काषायवसना जटिला मलपङ्किनी ।
दमयन्ती महाराज बाहुकं वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Then Damayanti, in ochre robes, with matted hair and a body smeared with dirt, O great king, spoke to Bahuka.

verses.text:
दृष्टपूर्वस्त्वया कश्चिद्धर्मज्ञो नाम बाहुक ।
सुप्तामुत्सृज्य विपिने गतो यः पुरुषः स्त्रियम् ॥

meaning.en: Bahuka, have you ever seen or heard of any man who knows dharma and yet went off, leaving his sleeping wife in a forest?

verses.text:
अनागसं प्रियां भार्यां विजने श्रममोहिताम् ।
अपहाय तु को गच्छेत्पुण्यश्लोकमृते नलम् ॥

meaning.en: Who would abandon a loved, blameless wife, worn out and bewildered, in a lonely place, except Nala of holy fame?

verses.text:
किं नु तस्य मया कार्यमपराद्धं महीपतेः ।
यो मामुत्सृज्य विपिने गतवान्निद्रया हृताम् ॥

meaning.en: What wrong did I do to that king, that he left me in the forest, overcome by sleep, and went away?

verses.text:
साक्षाद्देवानपाहाय वृतो यः स मया पुरा ।
अनुव्रतां साभिकामां पुत्रिणीं त्यक्तवान्कथम् ॥

meaning.en: I had chosen him in front of the gods themselves and turned them away. How could he abandon a devoted wife who loved him and had borne him children?

verses.text:
अग्नौ पाणिगृहीतां च हंसानां वचने स्थिताम् ।
भरिष्यामीति सत्यं च प्रतिश्रुत्य क्व तद्गतम् ॥

meaning.en: He took my hand before the fire, and I trusted the swan's word. He swore truly, "I will support you." Where has that vow gone?

verses.text:
दमयन्त्या ब्रुवन्त्यास्तु सर्वमेतदरिंदम ।
शोकजं वारि नेत्राभ्यामसुखं प्रास्रवद्बहु ॥

meaning.en: As Damayanti said all this, O subduer of foes, painful tears of sorrow poured copiously from her eyes.

verses.text:
अतीव कृष्णताराभ्यां रक्तान्ताभ्यां जलं तु तत् ।
परिस्रवन्नलो दृष्ट्वा शोकार्त इदमब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the water streaming from her eyes, black-pupilled and red at the corners, Nala, tormented by grief, said:

verses.text:
मम राज्यं प्रनष्टं यन्नाहं तत्कृतवान्स्वयम् ।
कलिना तत्कृतं भीरु यच्च त्वामहमत्यजम् ॥

meaning.en: The loss of my kingdom was not my own doing. It was Kali's doing, and so was my leaving you, timid one.

verses.text:
त्वया तु धर्मभृच्छ्रेष्ठे शापेनाभिहतः पुरा ।
वनस्थया दुःखितया शोचन्त्या मां विवाससम् ॥

meaning.en: But you, best of the steadfast, cursed him in the old days when you were in the forest, grieving and suffering, as I wandered with only half a garment.

verses.text:
स मच्छरीरे त्वच्छापाद्दह्यमानोऽवसत्कलिः ।
त्वच्छापदग्धः सततं सोऽग्नाविव समाहितः ॥

meaning.en: Because of your curse Kali dwelt in my body, burning there, scorched by your curse, as if he were held in fire.

verses.text:
मम च व्यवसायेन तपसा चैव निर्जितः ।
दुःखस्यान्तेन चानेन भवितव्यं हि नौ शुभे ॥

meaning.en: He has now been conquered by my resolve and by my austerity, and so our sorrow must end, auspicious lady.

verses.text:
विमुच्य मां गतः पापः स ततोऽहमिहागतः ।
त्वदर्थं विपुलश्रोणि न हि मेऽन्यत्प्रयोजनम् ॥

meaning.en: Leaving me, that sinner has gone. So I have come here, and for your sake, wide-hipped one; I have no other purpose.

verses.text:
कथं नु नारी भर्तारमनुरक्तमनुव्रतम् ।
उत्सृज्य वरयेदन्यं यथा त्वं भीरु कर्हिचित् ॥

meaning.en: But how could a woman ever abandon a devoted, loving husband and choose another, as you, timid one, are doing?

verses.text:
दूताश्चरन्ति पृथिवीं कृत्स्नां नृपतिशासनात् ।
भैमी किल स्म भर्तारं द्वितीयं वरयिष्यति ॥

meaning.en: On the king's orders messengers roam the whole earth announcing that Bhaimi will choose a second husband.

verses.text:
स्वैरवृत्ता यथाकाममनुरूपमिवात्मनः ।
श्रुत्वैव चैवं त्वरितो भाङ्गस्वरिरुपस्थितः ॥

meaning.en: They said she would act freely, as she pleased, choosing a match fit for herself. Hearing that, Rituparna rushed here.

verses.text:
दमयन्ती तु तच्छ्रुत्वा नलस्य परिदेवितम् ।
प्राञ्जलिर्वेपमाना च भीता वचनमब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Hearing Nala's lament, Damayanti, trembling and afraid, folded her hands and replied.
